plans.idea: Product family on the left, the big hero bag with the two smaller bags bottom-aligned beside it as a stepped lineup, and a tall right-hand copy column with the logo on top and the Build Your Pack button underneath, so the eye reads left to right: product, then message, then action.

A left-aligned editorial rail (logo, then copy stack, then the button, all on one left edge) set against a product cluster on the right, where the hero bag is large and the two smaller bags sit at its foot like a pack being built.

A three-part centred layout like the original's centre axis: the logo, copy and button stacked down the middle, the hero bag on the left side and the two smaller bags on the right side, so the product framing and the vertical reading order of the square original both survive.
